shared_elements: low-relief carving on a rectangular monolithic pillar
animal figures in profile carved in relief on the pillar's broad face
quadruped/predator-like creature with head shown at upper area
raised framed panel or band within which figures sit
T-shaped pillar head above the decorated shaft
justification: Both show a T-headed rectangular pillar whose broad face carries low-relief profile animals set within a raised rectangular framed panel, rendered in the same flat, schematic, outline-with-flat-infill convention with limbs and heads shown in strict profile. A is far richer, stacking multiple registers (row of arched motifs, band of zigzag/net pattern, a canid-like beast over a small figure, a plant-like frond and a large long-necked bird below), whereas B shows only a single sparse pair of small creatures in one panel, so the specific combinations and sequence of motifs do not match.
